content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(CDR-011 Container Escape via DIND nsenter or Host Namespace) AND XQL(CDR-011 Container Escape to Host Process Activity) — fuses the escape primitive with the resulting host-namespace process activity into one container-escape-chain incident.
rules.name: Kubernetes-Goat Escape Chain — Escape Primitive Then Host Process Activity
